organizations.nameVariants: Syrena-Grand-Record; Sirena-Grand-Record; Syrena Rekord; Syrena Electro; Towarzystwo „Syrena Record”
organizations.publicNote: Warsaw record company represented in the linked evidence by the Syrena Record, Syrena-Grand-Record and Syrena-Electro imprints. Melodia Record, Olimpia and Balto were associated labels rather than alternative names of Syrena Record.

sources.shortCitation: Syrena-Grand-Record 17919, “Jak się da, to się zrobi!” (1926)
sources.fullCitation: Perskie Oko Theatre Orchestra, conducted by Zygmunt Wiehler. “Jak się da, to się zrobi!” Music by Br. Asper [Bronisław Kaper]; words by Willy [Andrzej Włast]. Syrena-Grand-Record 17919, matrix 17919, 1926. Katalog Polskich Płyt Gramofonowych, record no. 38213.
sources.title: Jak się da, to się zrobi! — Syrena-Grand-Record 17919
sources.creator: Perskie Oko Theatre Orchestra; Zygmunt Wiehler, conductor

sources.shortCitation: Syrena Grand Record 17921, “A zresztą… niech pan zadzwoni” (1926)
sources.fullCitation: Orkiestra teatru „Perskie Oko”, conducted by Zygmunt Wiehler. “A zresztą… niech pan zadzwoni.” Shimmy. Syrena Grand Record 17921, matrix 17921, 1926. Transfer published by Stare Melodie from a privately held disc.
sources.title: A zresztą… niech pan zadzwoni — Syrena Grand Record 17921
sources.creator: Orkiestra teatru „Perskie Oko”; Zygmunt Wiehler, conductor
sources.researchNote: The upload description credits the music to Henryk Chwast under the pseudonym Bruno Asper. The attribution is resolved to Bronisław Kaper because both forms are independently documented as his pseudonyms.
